                    [32m' * @see https://trpc.io/docs/client/links/httpSubscriptionLink\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export function httpSubscriptionLink<\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  TInferrable extends InferrableClientTypes,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  TEventSource extends EventSourceLike.AnyConstructor,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'>(\n'[39m +

                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        const connectionSub = connectionState.subscribe({\n'[39m +

            [32m'## Task States and Management\n'[39m +
